units.source: Read-Only Notes
units.context: Read-Only Notes

units.source: Some note types such as __TRILIUM_PH_0__Text__TRILIUM_PH_1__, __TRILIUM_PH_2__Code__TRILIUM_PH_3__ notes and even some of the __TRILIUM_PH_4__Collections__TRILIUM_PH_5__ can be set to read-only. When a note is in read-only mode, it is presented to the user in a non-editable view, with the option to switch to editing mode if needed.
units.context: Read-Only Notes

units.source: Automatic read-only mode__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Read-Only Notes > Automatic read-only mode

units.source: For optimization purposes, Trilium will automatically set very large notes to read-only. Displaying such lengthy notes in editing mode can slow down performance, especially when editing is unnecessary.
units.context: Read-Only Notes > Automatic read-only mode

units.source: This behavior can be disabled on a per-note basis, by following the instructions of the next section.
units.context: Read-Only Notes > Automatic read-only mode

units.source: In addition, it's possible to change the number of characters at which the automatic read-only mode will trigger in __TRILIUM_PH_0__Options__TRILIUM_PH_1__ by going to the options for __TRILIUM_PH_2__Text Notes__TRILIUM_PH_3__ and __TRILIUM_PH_4__Code Notes__TRILIUM_PH_5__.
units.context: Read-Only Notes > Automatic read-only mode

units.source: Changing a note's read-only behavior__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Read-Only Notes > Changing a note's read-only behavior

units.source: A note's read-only behavior can be changed via __TRILIUM_PH_0__Note menu__TRILIUM_PH_1__ → __TRILIUM_PH_2__Editable.__TRILIUM_PH_3__ The following options are possible:
units.context: Read-Only Notes > Changing a note's read-only behavior

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Auto__TRILIUM_PH_1____TRILIUM_PH_2__This is the default behavior in which the note will be editable by default, unless it becomes large enough to trigger read-only mode.
units.context: Read-Only Notes > Changing a note's read-only behavior

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Read-only__TRILIUM_PH_1____TRILIUM_PH_2__The note will be always marked as read-only, regardless of its size. Nevertheless, it's still possible to temporarily edit the note if needed. This is generally useful for notes that are not prone to change.
units.context: Read-Only Notes > Changing a note's read-only behavior

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Always editable__TRILIUM_PH_1____TRILIUM_PH_2__This option will bypass the automatic read-only activation for this particular note. It's useful for large notes that are frequently edited.
units.context: Read-Only Notes > Changing a note's read-only behavior

units.source: If the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Editable__TRILIUM_PH_1__ section is missing from the __TRILIUM_PH_2__Note menu__TRILIUM_PH_3__, then the note type does not support read-only mode.
units.context: Read-Only Notes > Changing a note's read-only behavior

units.source: Manually setting the options__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Read-Only Notes > Changing a note's read-only behavior > Manually setting the options

units.source: Apart from using the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Note menu__TRILIUM_PH_1__ as previously mentioned, it's also possible to use __TRILIUM_PH_2__labels__TRILIUM_PH_3__ to change the behavior:
units.context: Read-Only Notes > Changing a note's read-only behavior > Manually setting the options

units.source: To set as read-only, apply the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ label to the note.
units.context: Read-Only Notes > Changing a note's read-only behavior > Manually setting the options

units.source: To disable automatic read-only (always editable), apply the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ label.
units.context: Read-Only Notes > Changing a note's read-only behavior > Manually setting the options

units.source: Temporarily editing a read-only note__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Read-Only Notes > Temporarily editing a read-only note

units.source: When accessing a read-only note, it's possible to temporarily edit it pressing the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Read-only__TRILIUM_PH_1__ badge.
units.context: Read-Only Notes > Temporarily editing a read-only note

units.source: When pressed, the note will become editable but will become read-only again after navigating to a different note.
units.context: Read-Only Notes > Temporarily editing a read-only note

units.source: The pages of the built-in user guide are an exception: they are part of Trilium itself and cannot be edited, not even temporarily. Their __TRILIUM_PH_0__Read-only__TRILIUM_PH_1__ badge cannot be pressed, the note menu does not offer to edit them, and their attributes are shown in the right sidebar without a way to change them.
units.context: Read-Only Notes > Temporarily editing a read-only note
